description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways - Wayamba University adding "Department of English Language Teaching - Order to amend the Gaz.Ex.No. 2093/8 of 17.08.1999 in relation to the Wayamba University adding "Department of English Language Teaching"
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to a university's departmental structure under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order made under statutory authority (Section 27(1)) to modify the existing legal framework governing the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka by adding a new department. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing personal portfolio responsibilities, making it a regulatory action rather than a government personnel or structural change.
